# Example creature — regression fixture

The two reference images, original animation sheet and landmarks are **test-only copies** of an existing Hellscape production sample. The source bytes are unchanged; the paths have moved so that the generic browser tests no longer depend on the Hellscape directory layout.

These are **not** example output for the user and are not imported by the production CLI or editor. They have not been relicensed for independent creative reuse. Replace these reference images with freely distributable generic fixtures in a later dedicated change if the new project is to receive an open-source license.
